title: 60 Among the Union Territories Delhi recorded the highest amount of value of property stolen during 1971 viz., 391.6 lakhs as against 186.2 lakhs during 1970 and the recovery was 23.4% of the total value of property stolen. The statistics regarding property stolen and recovered in the States and Union Territories by different categories of offences during 1971 are presented in Appendices 58—64.
